Serious Medical Problems (Second Edition)

[美] 布赖恩·瑟本（Brian Sebern） 绘

[P3] 森林边住着一棵快乐的小树，她的朋友阿曼达每天过来跟她玩。小树抖动着叶子沙沙作响，给阿曼达唱歌，阿曼达则给小树讲去遥远的田野里探险的故事。

[P4] 一天，阿曼达和小树正在说话，忽然，天上乌云密布、狂风大作。
阿曼达赶紧跑到森林深处躲了起来。
可小树只是一棵树呀，她只能一直站在那里。狂风吹啊吹，吹了
整晚，小树的树枝被甩得东倒西歪、前仰后合、上摇下晃。

[P5] 第二天早晨，风停了。
阿曼达跑回来看风暴过后的小树是不是还好。

小树看起来变了个样子，很多树枝都被折断了耷拉下来，大部分的叶子都被吹掉了。阿曼达赶紧来帮忙。

[P6] 她叫来两个树医生，一位叫想象太太，一位叫治疗先生。治疗先生轻轻地敲了敲小树的根，又摸了摸她的树皮。他说：“哦，你的树皮在发热，但你的根很强壮。”
接着，他爬上梯子检查小树的树枝。他仔细察看每根树枝，温柔地移动它们。想象太太把耳朵贴在小树的树干上听了听。她说：“嗯，你的心脏跳得很有劲呢。”

[P7] “我们先给你喝点草药降降体温，”治疗先生说，“但要想真正治好，我们就要修理你折（shé）了的树枝，剪掉那些修不好的。我们还要用柔软的树叶把伤口包扎（zā）起来，直到它们愈合。”

“我害怕。”小树轻声说。
“没关系，我们会帮你的。”想象太太说。

[P8] “阿曼达，请你紧紧挨着小树，
让她知道你在旁边陪着她。”想象
太太说。
“小树，请你在心里想象一片
云，如果那片云代表了害
怕的感觉，那么它是什么
样子？注意它的颜
色和形状哦。”

小树专心地想，阿曼达
则紧贴着她。过了一会儿，
小树说：“我看到了。”

[P9] “很好。现在想着这个画面，慢慢地深呼吸。然后想象这美丽的天空打着旋儿被吸进你的树干和树枝。这就是神奇快乐呼吸法。”

“很好，”想象太太说，“现在想一想，如果感觉好一些的话，云朵又是什么颜色和形状呢？”
小树想啊想，然后她说：“蓝色——像蓝天一样蓝，上面飘着软绵绵的白云，像一只只小动物。”

[P10] 等小树平静下来，治疗先生给她服用了一种特殊的药，让她很舒服，很想睡觉。

想象太太告诉她要记得经常做神奇快乐呼吸法。阿曼达一直陪着她。

接着，治疗先生很小心地把折（shé）了的树枝剪掉，用软软的白色叶子把伤口包好。

[P11] 接下来的几天几夜，阿曼达
都在给小树讲故事。无论她醒着还是
睡着了，阿曼达都跟她说话。因为，森林里
的人都知道，当你睡着了，做着美梦，会有一
些好的事情发生。
小树一天天强壮起来。

[P12] 但她还是很伤心。
她想念失去的树枝，有时候，甚至以为那些树枝还长在她身上。
“为什么我的树枝会断呢？”她问道，“难道是我做错了什么事？”
“你是一棵非常好的小树，这不是你的错。”治疗先生说。
想象太太摇摇头说：“小树，我也不知道为什么，这个问题我们至今都不知道答案。我只知道你有强壮的根和一颗勇敢的心，总有一天你会发现你的特别之处。”
小树想，自己的特别之处到底是什么呢？

[P13] 又过了些日子，治疗先生说：“我们今天把叶子绷（bēng）带拆掉吧，你可以看看你现在变成什么样子了。”
“你会看到你的样子变了，”想象太太说，“但最重要的是你要勇敢接受你现在的样子。”
小树看到池塘里的倒影时，都认不出自己了。她哭了起来，因为她光顾着寻找那些失去的树枝。
“小树，你看看池塘深处。”想象太太轻声说。
小树很努力地往池塘深处看。她看到了自己健壮的树干、深深扎根于大地的树根和一颗美丽的心。

[P14] “但是，小树，你看到你身上留下的树枝了吗？这些树枝很强壮，会长出漂亮的叶子，开出美丽的花。这些花将来会结出甜美的果子，到时候你可以跟森林里所有的朋友分享你的果子。”

小树想象着将来幸福的画面，高兴得沙沙地摇着叶子。她想，这大概就是想象太太说的“你会发现你的特别之处”的意思吧？

“我的树枝还能长回来吗？”
小树问。
想象太太说：“不能了。”

[P15] 没过多久，森林里的每个人又高兴地听到小树的歌声和笑声了。尤其是阿曼达，她真为有小树这样勇敢又特别的朋友而感到骄傲。

[P3] By the forest lived a happy little tree. Her friend Amanda came to play with her every day. The little tree rustled her leaves, singing to Amanda, while Amanda told the little tree stories of adventures in distant fields.

[P4] One day, Amanda and the little tree were talking when suddenly, dark clouds gathered and a fierce wind began to blow.
Amanda quickly ran into the deep forest to hide.
But the little tree was just a tree—she could only stand there. The wind blew and blew all night, making the tree's branches sway wildly, twisting and turning, up and down.

[P5] The next morning, the wind had stopped.
Amanda ran back to see if the little tree was okay after the storm.

The little tree looked different—many branches were broken and hanging down, and most of its leaves had been blown off. Amanda hurried to help.

[P6] She called two tree doctors, one named Mrs. Imagine and the other Mr. Treat. Mr. Treat gently tapped the tree's roots and then touched her bark. He said, "Oh, your bark is warm, but your roots are strong." 
Next, he climbed a ladder to check the tree's branches. He carefully examined each branch, gently moving them. Mrs. Imagine pressed her ear against the tree trunk and listened. She said, "Hmm, your heart is beating strongly."

[P7] "We'll start by giving you some herbal medicine to lower your temperature," said Doctor Treatment, "but to truly heal, we need to fix your broken branches, trim away the ones that can't be repaired, and use soft leaves to bandage your wounds until they heal."

"I'm scared," whispered the little tree.
"Don't worry, we'll help you," said Mrs. Imagination.

[P8] "Amanda, please stay close to the little tree,
so she knows you're right beside her," said Imagine
Lady.
"Little tree, please imagine a cloud in your mind.
If that cloud represents the feeling of fear,
what does it look like? Pay attention to its color
and shape."

The little tree thought carefully, while Amanda
stayed close to her. After a while,
the little tree said, "I see it."

[P9] "Good. Now think of this picture, breathe in slowly and deeply. Then imagine this beautiful sky swirling into your trunk and branches. This is the Magic Happy Breathing Method."

"Good," said Imagine Lady, "now think, if you're feeling a bit better, what color and shape are the clouds?"
Little Tree thought and thought, then said, "Blue—like the sky, with soft, fluffy white clouds, like little animals."

[P10] After the little tree calmed down, Doctor Treatment gave her a special medicine that made her feel very comfortable and sleepy.

Imaginative Lady told her to remember to do the magical happy breathing exercise often. Amanda stayed with her all the time.

Next, Doctor Treatment carefully cut off the broken branches and wrapped the wounds with soft white leaves.

[P11] For the next few days and nights, Amanda
kept telling stories to the little tree. Whether she was awake or asleep,
Amanda kept talking to her. Because, as everyone in the forest knows,
when you're asleep and dreaming sweet dreams, good things happen.
The little tree grew stronger day by day.

[P12] But she was still very sad.
She missed her lost branches, and sometimes even thought they were still growing on her.
"Why did my branches break?" she asked, "Did I do something wrong?"
"You are a very good little tree, and it's not your fault," said Doctor Treatment.
Imaginative Lady shook her head and said, "Little tree, I don't know why. We still don't know the answer to this question. I only know you have strong roots and a brave heart. One day, you will discover your special quality."
The little tree wondered, what exactly was her special quality?

[P13] After a few more days, Doctor Treatment said, "Let's take off the leaf bandage today. You can see what you've become now."
"You'll see your appearance has changed," said Mrs. Imagination, "but the most important thing is to bravely accept yourself as you are now."
The little tree looked at her reflection in the pond and couldn't recognize herself. She started crying because she was only focused on searching for the lost branches.
"Little tree, look deeper into the pond," Mrs. Imagination said softly.
The little tree tried hard to look deeper into the pond. She saw her strong trunk, roots deeply anchored in the earth, and a beautiful heart.

[P14] "But, little tree, do you see the branches left on your body? These branches are strong, and they will grow beautiful leaves and bloom lovely flowers. These flowers will later bear sweet fruits, and then you can share your fruits with all your forest friends."

The little tree imagined a happy future, happily rustling her leaves. She thought, this must be what Mrs. Imagination meant by 'you will discover your special place.'

"Can my branches grow back?"
asked the little tree.
Mrs. Imagination said, "No, they cannot."

[P15] Not long after, everyone in the forest was happy to hear the little tree's singing and laughter again. Especially Amanda, she was truly proud to have such a brave and special friend as the little tree.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《小树》的封面，展示了书名、作者、插画师、出版社及美国心理学会官方授权等信息，配图是一棵大树和一只松鼠。
[P2] 本页为绘本《小树》的扉页，展示了书名、作者、插画师、译者、出版社等信息，并配有大树和松鼠的插图。
[P3] 本页描绘了森林边一棵快乐的小树和她的朋友阿曼达松鼠，它们每天一起玩耍，小树用叶子沙沙声唱歌，阿曼达则为小树讲述田野探险的故事。
[P4] 一场暴风雨突然来袭，阿曼达松鼠躲进森林深处，而小树只能在狂风中摇晃，无法躲避。
[P5] 风暴过后，阿曼达松鼠回到小树身边，发现小树的树枝被折断、叶子被吹落，于是赶紧前来帮忙。
[P6] 小树在风暴后受伤，阿曼达松鼠请来了两位树医生——想象太太和治疗先生。治疗先生检查了小树的根和树皮，想象太太则倾听树干，判断小树虽然受伤但生命力依然旺盛。
[P7] 治疗先生和想象太太为受伤的小树制定治疗方案，小树感到害怕，想象太太安慰她会得到帮助。
[P8] 想象太太指导小树通过想象云朵来面对恐惧，阿曼达松鼠在一旁陪伴，小树最终表示自己看到了想象中的云。
[P9] 想象太太指导小树通过想象云朵来缓解恐惧，小树在阿曼达松鼠的陪伴下，描述了她想象中蓝色天空和像小动物一样的白云。
[P10] 治疗先生为受伤的小树服药并包扎伤口，想象太太指导她做呼吸法，阿曼达松鼠全程陪伴在旁。
[P11] 在月光下的森林里，阿曼达松鼠持续陪伴受伤的小树，为她讲故事，小树在她的陪伴下一天天恢复健康。
[P12] 小树因树枝断裂而伤心自责，治疗先生安慰她这不是她的错，想象太太则鼓励她拥有强壮的根和勇敢的心，终将发现自己的特别之处。
[P13] 治疗先生为小树拆除了叶子绷带，想象太太鼓励她接受现在的样子。小树在池塘倒影中因认不出自己而哭泣，想象太太引导她看向深处，小树最终看到了自己健壮的树干、扎根的树根和美丽的心。
[P14] 小树询问自己的树枝是否还能长回来，想象太太告诉她不能了，但鼓励她看到现有树枝的潜力，未来会长出叶子、花朵和果实，与朋友们分享。
[P15] 森林恢复了生机，小树重新快乐起来，阿曼达松鼠为她感到骄傲，其他动物们也享受着宁静美好的森林生活。
[P16] 页面中央有一个圆形插图，描绘了一只棕色的松鼠站在草地上，怀中抱着一个红色的果实，周围点缀着白色小花，背景是绿色的草地和树木，整体画面温馨宁静。
